item.title: V Lang vs Go vs C in 2026: Is the 38K-Star Language Ready for Production?
item.description: A language with 37,945 GitHub stars, an official claim of ≈500,000 lines compiled per second, and a compiler that bootstraps itself in under a second is either the most interesting systems language of the decade or a very well-marketed side project. V is both, depending on what you ask it to do.
